description: Takes a gate in and puts out one of its own, at a length and after a delay you set

params.text: Sets the length of the output gate, 1ms to 1 second
Sets the delay between the incoming gate and the start of the output gate, 0ms to 1 second

inputs.text: Adds to the LENGTH knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the DELAY knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
The gate that starts the delay and the output pulse

outputs.text: An 8V gate of the length set by LENGTH

notes: Both CVs are read once, at the moment the incoming gate rises; moving them during a pulse changes nothing until the next one.

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
